cohort: Exactly all250 previously defined compression-required questions with candidate_cost>256 from Step100, regardless of outcomes. This curve is conditional on that cohort, not the350-question primary table. All three budgets retain every selected question.
scope: Known benchmark compression cohort, fixed representation, one fixed8B reader stack. Completed4B256 main results remain separate. This is not new-source confirmation or a weights-only comparison.
cost_policy: Report actual new calls and partial attempts separately from imported reader cost and prior fixed-graph construction. Per-budget logical cold-start construction includes graph cost whenever compression is required; skip it when the full pool fits. Plain_set never pays graph construction. Historical retrieval/ranking costs remain unknown. Source cap does not equalize cumulative tokens or compute.
decision: All three budget points and prespecified controls are reported. No prompt/model/threshold/seed tuning, no output repair, no extra candidate pruning, no auto rerun of valid or invalid completed calls.
mechanism_scope: Automatic graph coverage is a diagnostic, not independent semantic evidence certification. Budget variation alone is not the targeted deletion mechanism experiment.
